form.system.searchindex.common.adminRequ: Administrator role is required to rebuild the search index.
form.system.searchindex.start.title: Rebuild Search Index
form.system.searchindex.start.subtitle: Rebuild the full-text search index of every cluster node from the repository content.
form.system.searchindex.start.descriptio: The rebuild runs in the background on each node. Search and content updates keep working throughout; the new index replaces the old one atomically when it is complete.
form.system.searchindex.start.note.progr: A progress task will appear in your task list; open it any time to watch every node, abort, or re-run failed nodes.
form.system.searchindex.start.note.durat: Depending on repository size this can take a long time. Only one rebuild should run at a time.
form.system.searchindex.start.started: The rebuild has been requested. Open the "Search Index Rebuild Progress" task from your task list to follow it.
form.system.searchindex.progress.title: Search Index Rebuild Progress
form.system.searchindex.progress.notTarg: not targeted (joined later; rebuilds on startup)
form.system.searchindex.progress.running: The rebuild is running. You can close this window; the task stays in your task list and shows the live state whenever you reopen it.
form.system.searchindex.progress.someFai: {count, plural, one {# node} other {# nodes}} did not complete.
form.system.searchindex.progress.openFro: Open this form from the "Search Index Rebuild Progress" task.
